name: Glutinous Rice and Chinese Sausage Wrapped in Banana Leaves

ingredients.name: Chinese sausage, cut at a diagonal into 1 inch slices

instructions.primary_message: Cook glutinous rice in a rice cooker and let cool slightly (see notes). Mix in soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar until seasonings are well-distributed.

Lay large rectangular sections of the banana leaves on a cutting board. Layer slightly smaller rectangular sections cross-wise. Add a few tablespoons of rice mixture on leaves. Place a few segments of the sausage in the center and top with a few more tablespoons of rice. Fold the inside layer of the banana leaves over rice, followed by the outside layer. Tie with cooking twine. Repeat until you have 6 to 8 packages.

Arrange the packets in a steamer and steam over medium heat for 1 hour, replenishing with more water as needed. Serve hot. Unwrapped leftover packets may be frozen for longer storage. It is not necessary to thaw before reheating in a steamer.

schema_metadata.keywords: Asian, banana leaves, glutinous rice, rice, Seriously Asian

description: Carefully wrapped bundles of rice and sausage are chewy, salty, and packed with floral flavor.
notes:
Optional substitutions: lard → a neutral-tasting oil

Notes: Banana leaves are available in dried or frozen form in most Asian markets. If you buy dried leaves, soak them in water overnight before use.
To cook glutinous rice on the stovetop, see this recipe.
author: Chichi Wang
